name: Plex-Auto-Languages
description: Plex Auto Languages enhances your Plex experience by automatically updating the audio and subtitle settings of TV shows based on your preferences. Similar to Netflix, it remembers your language preferences for each TV show without interfering with global settings or other users' preferences.

variables.name: Plex - URL
variables.description: The URL of your Plex server

variables.name: Update Level
variables.description: Update language for the entire show or only the current season (accepted values: 'show' or 'season')

variables.name: Update Strategy
variables.description: Update all episodes of the show/season or only the next ones (accepted values: 'next' or 'all')

variables.name: Trigger on Play
variables.description: Enable language update when playing a file (default: 'true')

variables.name: Trigger on Scan
variables.description: Enable language update when scanning the library for new files (default: 'true')

variables.name: Trigger on Activity
variables.description: Enable language update when navigating the Plex library (default: 'false')

variables.name: Refresh Library on Scan
variables.description: Refresh the cached library when the Plex server scans its library (default: 'true')

variables.name: Ignore Labels
variables.description: Ignore shows with the following Plex labels (comma-separated, e.g., LABEL1,LABEL2)

variables.name: Notifications Apprise Configs
variables.description: JSON array of Apprise notification configurations. See Apprise docs for more information: https://github.com/caronc/apprise.

variables.name: Debug Mode
variables.description: Enable debug mode for detailed logs (default: 'false')
